event_name: NAPA Auto Parts NHRA Midwest Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 69 degrees, relative humidity 57 percent, barometer 30.19 inches, adjusted
altitude 1,235 feet, track temperature 82 degrees.

Cody Anderson has never “left first” against Enders. Erica Enders is 12-15 in Round 1 when starting No. 9.

Enders is 3 - 2 against Anderson in prior events.

Enders with a great light, but Anderson chased her down in the lights for the win in a close one. Cody
Anderson's MOV: 0.0009 seconds (approximately 3 inches).

Jeg Coughlin is 350-146 (71%) in Round 1 races. Matt Latino is 20-6 (77%) in Round 1.

Latino and Coughlin have each won 1 times against the other in prior events. 

Latino goes red to give Coughlin the win.

Eric Latino set Low E.T. here last year with a 6.515. This is just the fourth time in his last 44 races that
Dallas Glenn has started in the bottom half of the field.

Glenn is 4 - 1 against Latino in prior events. 

Latino goes red to give Glenn the win. He makes his quickest pass of the weekend.

Matt Hartford’s 186 round wins are tied with B. Butner for the 20th-most in PS history. Stephen Bell is making
his 16th career start.

Hartford is 1 - 0 against Bell in prior events. 

Bell with the starting line advantage, but Hartford chased him down by half track and took the win.   Matt
Hartford's MOV: 0.0190 seconds (approximately 6 feet).

Aaron Stanfield is 1-5 in Round 1 over his last six races. Deric Kramer is 2-15 in Round 1 when qualified No.
13.


Stanfield is 8 - 3 against Kramer in prior events. 

Kramer goes red to give Stanfield the win.  He will give up lane choice to Hartford in the next round

Greg Anderson wins 83% of his Round 1 races when starting from the top half of the field, including 81% when
starting No. 3. Kenny Delco’s first race against Greg Anderson came in Atlanta in 2016.

Anderson is 17 - 2 against Delco in prior events. 

Delco goes red to give Anderson the win.  Anderson is straight down the groove with a good pass, he will have
lane choice over Glenn in the next round.

It has been 74 races since Troy Coughlin Jr.’s last No. 1 qualifying position. The No. 16 PS qualifier has won
Round 1 just once at this event — Troy Coughlin Jr. in 2025.

This is the first time Vang and Coughlin Jr. have faced each other in eliminations.

Coughlin Jr. with a great light and the quickest pass of race day for the win.  He will have lane choice over
Cody Anderson in the next round.

Greg Stanfield’s first race as a professional came at this track in 1999 in Pro Stock Truck. Mason McGaha is
making his 89th career start.

Stanfield is 2 - 0 against McGaha in prior events.

Stanfield with the starting line advantage and makes the quickest pass of race day for the win.  He will have
lane choice over Jeg Coughlin in the next round.

McGaha with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.
